verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no bulk operation capability, such as multi-select delete, batch conversion, or batch export of many items at once. Selecting several sources to scope a chat, and generating artifacts from all sources, are related features rather than bulk item operations. The only note-conversion doc describes converting a single note, and the community email-import example is a user-side workaround with external tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
